pages.text: Earn these from bosses — nothing else drops them. Simply Swords uniques are the best weapons in the pack: not craftable, not tradeable, never in chests, each matched thematically to its boss.$(br2)$(bold)42 unique weapons$() exist across all 4 tiers. Drop chances run 8% (rarest) to 25% (Ender Dragon's Waking Lichblade) — expect 6–8 kills to see a drop.
